name: Rhoda (servant)
title: The Joyful Servant Girl
summary: Rhoda was a servant in the house of Mary, the mother of John Mark, in Jerusalem. She is known for recognizing the voice of the apostle Peter at the gate after his miraculous release from prison, but was so overwhelmed with joy that she forgot to open the door for him.

keyEvents.title: Recognizes Peter's Voice
keyEvents.description: When Peter knocked at the gate after being freed from prison by an angel, Rhoda came to open it. She recognized Peter's voice and was filled with joy.

keyEvents.title: Forgets to Open the Door
keyEvents.description: In her great joy upon hearing Peter's voice, Rhoda forgot to open the gate and instead ran inside to tell the others that Peter was standing outside.

keyEvents.title: Not Believed
keyEvents.description: When Rhoda told those who were praying that Peter was at the gate, they did not believe her and said she was out of her mind. They thought it must be his angel.

keyEvents.title: Peter Confirms Her Testimony
keyEvents.description: Peter continued to knock, and when they finally opened the door and saw him, they were amazed. Rhoda's testimony proved to be true.
